functional_requirements.description: ATM Login
The system shall validate customer card number and PIN credentials.
The system shall reject login attempts with invalid credentials.
The system shall display the main transaction menu after successful authentication.
Cash Withdrawal
The system shall validate that the withdrawal amount does not exceed the account balance.
The system shall deduct the withdrawal amount from the customer's account balance.
The system shall persist the withdrawal transaction record in the database.
The system shall display a withdrawal success message to the customer.
Cash Deposit
The system shall accept the deposit amount entered by the customer.
The system shall add the deposit amount to the customer's account balance.
The system shall persist the deposit transaction record in the database.
Fast Cash Withdrawal
The system shall provide predefined fast cash amount options to the customer.
The system shall reject fast cash withdrawal if balance is insufficient.
PIN Change
The system shall prompt the customer to enter and confirm a new PIN.
The system shall verify that both PIN entries match.
The system shall update the customer PIN in the database.
Balance Enquiry
The system shall retrieve current account balance from transaction records.
The system shall display current account balance to the customer.
Mini Statement
The system shall retrieve recent customer transaction records.
The system shall display mini statement information including transaction type and amount.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide a GUI similar to a real ATM machine.
The system shall respond to customer operations within acceptable desktop application response time.
The system shall restrict banking operations to authenticated users only.
The system shall persist transaction data using MySQL database storage.
